entry.title: Consent does not live in a button
entry.summary: We spent a year adding a staging area so people could approve things one at a time, and then found they were approving in conversation anyway. The button was a record of a decision made somewhere else.

entry.title: Notes you did not write for anyone
entry.summary: The margin of a book is the least performative writing most people do. Software that syncs it somewhere should be able to say, precisely, who else can read it.

entry.title: Against the infinite shelf
entry.summary: A reader that never lets anything settle is a reader you eventually stop opening. Read items should recede, not vanish.
